description: Write comprehensive unit tests for useUnifiedDownload hook covering platform detection, URL construction (the iOS absolute URL fix), download paths (iOS, Desktop, Android), cancellation, progress tracking, and error handling. Use Jest + @testing-library/react per project test setup.
steps: 1. Create src/hooks/__tests__/useUnifiedDownload.test.ts. Set up Jest test file with imports: useUnifiedDownload, @testing-library/react (renderHook, act, waitFor), mock modules for streamSaver.ts and downloads.ts.

2. Mock isIOS(), isAndroidMobileChrome(), streamDownloadToDisk, triggerAttachmentDownload, toIOSDownloadHref, getBackendOrigin(). Use jest.mock() at the top of the file. Reference jest.config.js for module name mapping (@/ resolves to src/).

3. Test case: 'detects iOS platform and uses triggerAttachmentDownload'. Mock isIOS() to return true. Call startDownload with a relative URL like '/api/download/file?...'. Assert that getBackendOrigin() was called and triggerAttachmentDownload received an absolute URL starting with 'https://'.

4. Test case: 'builds absolute URLs for iOS using getBackendOrigin'. Mock getBackendOrigin() to return 'https://test-backend.railway.app'. Pass a relative URL '/api/download/file?url=...'. Assert triggerAttachmentDownload was called with 'https://test-backend.railway.app/api/download/file?url=...'.
5. Test case: 'uses streamDownloadToDisk for Desktop'. Mock isIOS() to return false. Call startDownload. Assert streamDownloadToDisk was called with the correct URL, filename, and callbacks.

6. Test case: 'tracks progress during download'. Mock streamDownloadToDisk to call onProgress callback with (500, 1000). Assert hook.progress.downloaded === 500, hook.progress.total === 1000, hook.progress.percent === 50.

7. Test case: 'cancellation aborts in-flight download'. Call startDownload, then immediately call cancelDownload(). Assert that the AbortController's abort() was called and isDownloading becomes false.

8. Test case: 'handles errors and sets error state'. Mock streamDownloadToDisk to throw new Error('Network error'). Call startDownload. Assert hook.error === 'Network error' and isDownloading === false.
9. Test case: 'onComplete callback fires on success'. Mock streamDownloadToDisk to resolve successfully. Pass onComplete spy. Assert the spy was called once after download completes.
10. Test case: 'onError callback fires on failure'. Mock streamDownloadToDisk to reject. Pass onError spy. Assert the spy was called with the error.
11. Run tests: `npm test -- useUnifiedDownload.test.ts` and confirm all tests pass.
